verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows LightSprint issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The closest items are adjacent controls: GitHub-mapped merge permissions, sandbox egress control, model-gateway routing, bring-your-own model API keys and secret scrubbing. None of these is a mechanism for minting scoped agent credentials, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404 with no public API surface found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
